body:
Closed the previously-named gap: is-valid-i32-text?'s own real if-shaped loop-binding init (new if-value-shaped?/emit-if-value, a real ternary-emitting sibling of if-tail-shaped?). Found and fixed a real, live segfault via gdb: emit-recur-temps called emit-loop-binding-value unconditionally on every recur argument with zero shape gate. Fixed with a real shape gate (clean #error instead of a crash), then closed the actual named gap: or/and/not-shaped loop-binding values via emit-bool-expr. 8 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check. Re-ran the self-compile diagnostic: is-valid-i32-text? now emits ZERO #error directives. Two new, separate, honestly-named gaps found (not fixed): a boolean tail-value in loop position, and undefined true/false in the runtime header. make test: 347/347, zero regressions.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-host: if/or/and/not-shaped loop-binding values + a real live segfault fixed
